newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian stocks down slightly in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian stocks down slightly in quiet trade.

text.p: Shares on the Jordanian stock exchange fell 0.04 percent on Saturday in quiet trade dominated by the recently-merged Jordan National Bank.
The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index fell 0.06 points to 156.23 points in trade worth 459,000 dinars ($648,000).
Jordan National Bank, relisted last week after merging with the Business Bank, closed unchanged at 2.03 dinars after turnover of over 100,000 dinars.
The shares rose as high as 2.10 dinars last Tuesday after the merger, which raised the capital of the combined bank above the Central Bank requirement of 20 million dinars.
Jordan Cement Factory was also busy, rising 0.04 dinars to 3.48 dinars in trade worth 94,000 dinars.

Overall 15 shares fell, 14 rose and another eight traded but closed unchanged. The private Pearl Index of the 45 most-traded shares on the exchange rose 0.14 percent to 82.63 points, still 0.91 percent down from the start of the year.
